visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with extremely frizzy, voluminous dark brown hair stands in front of a neutral-colored wall decorated with two landscape paintings showing mountains and camels. He wears black-rimmed glasses and a black t-shirt, looking directly at the camera with a steady expression. (2) The scene shifts to a bright hair salon with large mirrors and white styling chairs. The man sits while a young woman in a white t-shirt and grey sweatpants styles his hair. He holds a smartphone, capturing the process in the mirror. (3) A macro close-up shot shows the man's hair being meticulously wrapped in silver foil by the stylist's hands. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the texture of the hair and the reflective foil. (4) Back in a home living room, the man reveals his new, tightly curled hairstyle. He stands near a woman with long dark hair who is seated on the floor, watching television. The room is warmly lit with domestic furnishings. (5) The man demonstrates the hair's elasticity by pressing it down firmly with his hand; it instantly springs back to its original frizzy shape. A young boy in a yellow and blue shirt enters the frame, looking up at the hair. (6) In the final phase, the man leans down playfully to "attack" the young boy with his spiky hair. The boy laughs and runs across the living room carpet, dodging the man's advances in a dynamic, handheld shot.
